title: Alweda Zehra ke laal
body:
Alveda Zehra ke laal alveda Zehra ke laal.
Fatima ke noreain ibne Shahe Mashraqain, Zainabo bekas ke chain alveda Zehra ke laal.
Shah ko hai dam badam bali Sakina ka ghum, Kehte hai rokar haram alveda Zehra ke laal.
Har koi dilgeer hai ghum ki yeh Taseer hai, Matame Shabbir hai alveda Zehra ke laal.
Kehti hai Zainab hazeen choom kar Sheh ki jabeen, Koi hamara nahi alveda Zehra ke laal.
Akbaro Asgher Salaam Qasime bepar Salaam, Saniye Haider Salaam alveda Zehra ke laal.
